test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To bridge the gap
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• For the idiom** "To bridge the gap",** the correct answer is "To reduce differences and reconcile" (अंतर को घटाना).
 
• This** idiom is used when** there is a need to lessen the differences or disparities between two things or situations.
